mechanism_of_action: Selective inhibitor of apoptosis signal-regulating kinase 1 (ASK1).
primary_endpoint: Proportion with ≥1-stage improvement in fibrosis without worsening of NASH at week 48.
efficacy_outcome: Neither trial met the primary endpoint. STELLAR-3: 10% (18 mg; p=0.49) and 12% (6 mg; p=0.93) vs 13% with placebo; STELLAR-4: 14% (18 mg; p=0.56) and 13% (6 mg; p=0.93) vs 13% with placebo.
safety_signal: Rates and types of adverse events were similar in selonsertib and placebo groups.
